title: IonQ 糾纏門：運動相空間閉合時間
titleEn: IonQ entangling gates: motional phase-space closure time
summary: 建立『IonQ 糾纏門：運動相空間閉合時間』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付相空間迴圈、閉合殘差與幾何相位待驗清單。
summaryEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IonQ entangling gates: motional phase-space closure time', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver phase-space loops, closure residuals and unverified geometric-phase requirements.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

knowledge.textEn: IonQ uses lasers to control trapped ions and entangle ion pairs.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立『IonQ 糾纏門：運動相空間閉合時間』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付相空間迴圈、閉合殘差與幾何相位待驗清單。
knowledge.textEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IonQ entangling gates: motional phase-space closure time', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver phase-space loops, closure residuals and unverified geometric-phase requirements.

knowledge.title: 推導與名義結果
knowledge.text: 名義代入：1/20e3*1e6 = 50 μs。變更代入：1/25e3*1e6 = 40 μs。情境數據與驗收門檻為原創教學假設；標準物理常數保留其定義。須連同模型適用條件解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal substitution: 1/20e3*1e6 = 50 μs. Changed substitution: 1/25e3*1e6 = 40 μs. Scenario inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching assumptions; standard physical constants retain their definitions. Interpret results within the model's applicability conditions.

quiz.question: 對「案例介面與可識別量」執行以下研究後，哪一項是直接驗收條件？依『IonQ 糾纏門：運動相空間閉合時間』畫出最小系統邊界，將下列量分成控制、狀態與量測三欄：教學失諧δ/(2π)=20 kHz；以μs求一圈時間，排除其他模式。 對照案例來源，只保留其實際支持的架構敘述；把所有合成數值標記『教學』。
quiz.questionEn: After this investigation for Case interfaces and identifiable quantities, which is the direct acceptance criterion? Draw the smallest system boundary for 'IonQ entangling gates: motional phase-space closure time'. Classify these quantities as controls, states or measurements: Teaching detuning δ/(2π)=20 kHz; solve one-loop time in μs with other modes excluded. Keep only architectural claims supported by the case source and label every synthetic value 'teaching'.
options: 故障表須能區分物理／資源異常與量測／記錄錯誤，並回到此核對後才結案：用exp(iδt)的cos與sin分量驗證終點(1,0)；另列需調整的力幅度以維持幾何相位。 重驗仍需重現名義或有明確版本的變更結果。
介面表應明示輸出單位μs、全部輸入與下列模型限制：單模式驅動的相空間迴圈在δt=2π時閉合；δ為rad/s。閉合本身不保證正確糾纏相位。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。
名義結果應為50 μs（展示值允許最後一位四捨五入），且獨立核對通過。保留被忽略的效應，不用單一吻合值取代模型驗證。
optionsEn: The fault table must distinguish physical/resource anomalies from measurement/record errors, and return to this check before closure: Check endpoint(1,0) using cos and sin of δt; separately list force-amplitude adjustment needed to preserve geometric phase. Recovery must reproduce the nominal or explicitly versioned changed result.

The interface table must state output unit μs, all inputs and these model limits: A single-mode driven phase-space loop closes when δt=2π, with δ in rad/s; closure alone does not guarantee the desired entangling phase. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.
Nominal result must be 50 μs allowing rounding of the last displayed digit, with the independent check passed. Retain omitted effects; one matching number is not model validation.
quiz.explanation: 介面表應明示輸出單位μs、全部輸入與下列模型限制：單模式驅動的相空間迴圈在δt=2π時閉合；δ為rad/s。閉合本身不保證正確糾纏相位。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。
quiz.explanationEn: The interface table must state output unit μs, all inputs and these model limits: A single-mode driven phase-space loop closes when δt=2π, with δ in rad/s; closure alone does not guarantee the desired entangling phase. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.

steps.titleEn: Case interfaces and identifiable quantities · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「案例介面與可識別量」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Case interfaces and identifiable quantities and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
殘留運動糾纏可來自失諧漂移或多模式激發；比較門後邊帶與不同模式頻率，不只量人口。
對照「案例介面與可識別量」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。40 μs只通過單模式閉合驗收；還需糾纏相位與熱敏感度證據，不能稱為完整高保真門設計。
本階段必須重驗：介面表應明示輸出單位μs、全部輸入與下列模型限制：單模式驅動的相空間迴圈在δt=2π時閉合；δ為rad/s。閉合本身不保證正確糾纏相位。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。
steps.instructionEn:
Residual motion entanglement may arise from detuning drift or multiple modes; inspect post-gate sidebands and mode frequencies, not population alone.
Against the nominal Case interfaces and identifiable quantities result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Forty μs passes only single-mode closure; entangling phase and thermal sensitivity remain required for a full gate design.
Reverify this criterion: The interface table must state output unit μs, all inputs and these model limits: A single-mode driven phase-space loop closes when δt=2π, with δ in rad/s; closure alone does not guarantee the desired entangling phase. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。殘留運動糾纏可來自失諧漂移或多模式激發；比較門後邊帶與不同模式頻率，不只量人口。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Residual motion entanglement may arise from detuning drift or multiple modes; inspect post-gate sidebands and mode frequencies, not population alone.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

Interpret it with the investigation criterion: The interface table must state output unit μs, all inputs and these model limits: A single-mode driven phase-space loop closes when δt=2π, with δ in rad/s; closure alone does not guarantee the desired entangling phase. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Case interfaces and identifiable quantities and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付相空間迴圈、閉合殘差與幾何相位待驗清單。
在交接件中加入「案例介面與可識別量」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：介面表應明示輸出單位μs、全部輸入與下列模型限制：單模式驅動的相空間迴圈在δt=2π時閉合；δ為rad/s。閉合本身不保證正確糾纏相位。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立『IonQ 糾纏門：運動相空間閉合時間』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付相空間迴圈、閉合殘差與幾何相位待驗清單。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver phase-space loops, closure residuals and unverified geometric-phase requirements.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Case interfaces and identifiable quantities: The interface table must state output unit μs, all inputs and these model limits: A single-mode driven phase-space loop closes when δt=2π, with δ in rad/s; closure alone does not guarantee the desired entangling phase. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IonQ entangling gates: motional phase-space closure time', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver phase-space loops, closure residuals and unverified geometric-phase requirements. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: IonQ 以雷射操作囚禁離子並支援離子對的糾纏。
knowledge.textEn: IonQ uses lasers to control trapped ions and entangle ion pairs.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立『IonQ 糾纏門：運動相空間閉合時間』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付相空間迴圈、閉合殘差與幾何相位待驗清單。
knowledge.textEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IonQ entangling gates: motional phase-space closure time', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver phase-space loops, closure residuals and unverified geometric-phase requirements.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 單模式驅動的相空間迴圈在δt=2π時閉合；δ為rad/s。閉合本身不保證正確糾纏相位。
knowledge.textEn: A single-mode driven phase-space loop closes when δt=2π, with δ in rad/s; closure alone does not guarantee the desired entangling phase.

stages.title: 案例介面與可識別量
stages.description: 依『IonQ 糾纏門：運動相空間閉合時間』畫出最小系統邊界，將下列量分成控制、狀態與量測三欄：教學失諧δ/(2π)=20 kHz；以μs求一圈時間，排除其他模式。 對照案例來源，只保留其實際支持的架構敘述；把所有合成數值標記『教學』。
stages.descriptionEn: Draw the smallest system boundary for 'IonQ entangling gates: motional phase-space closure time'. Classify these quantities as controls, states or measurements: Teaching detuning δ/(2π)=20 kHz; solve one-loop time in μs with other modes excluded. Keep only architectural claims supported by the case source and label every synthetic value 'teaching'.
